## Use and limits

Use the JSON ranking only to order applicable ideas. Compute each person’s number with `LifeTwinModel.compare()` and label it a modeled difference between profiles. The scan is observational and cannot establish the benefit of changing a habit. BMI remains excluded from app recommendations despite its fitted positive association above 35. The model supports only years 1–5 for complete, supported profiles. The reference is an unweighted 2,000-row NHANES sample; BMI 23–35 and sleep 7–8 hours were imputed within regions where the model is flat. These IQRs describe spread across profiles, not model uncertainty.

Owner override (2026-10-24): a rough age range and year may be shown once as a labeled proof of concept using the separate [lifespan method](lifespan-estimate.md). This sensitivity scan does not provide years gained or a validated death age.
